submitted_root_cause: Checkoutservice is experiencing high CPU throttling (53.9%) due to insufficient CPU limits, causing liveness probe failures and pod restarts. The service has a CPU limit of 600m but is being throttled significantly, indicating the workload requires more CPU resources than allocated.
submitted_action: Increase CPU limit from 600m to 1000m and CPU request from 250m to 400m to reduce throttling and prevent liveness probe timeouts
